findings.explanation: You must perform additional services requested by the client during the term at no extra charge, which can result in significant unpaid work.
findings.suggested_change: Any additional services requested by the Client shall be agreed upon in a written change order and billed at the Contractor's standard rates.

findings.quoted_text: [CLIENT_NAME] may request unlimited revisions until [CLIENT_NAME] is fully satisfied with each Deliverable.
findings.explanation: The client is entitled to unlimited revision rounds until they are fully satisfied, which can trap you in endless unpaid work.
findings.suggested_change: The Client may request up to three (3) rounds of revisions for each Deliverable, and any further revisions will be subject to additional fees.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to suggest a few minor changes before we proceed. - Regarding the relevant clause about additional services, the requirement to perform extra work without charge can lead to unpaid tasks, so I propose that any additional services be agreed upon in a written change order and billed at standard rates. - Regarding the relevant clause concerning revisions, allowing unlimited rounds can result in endless unpaid work, so I propose limiting this to a set number of rounds with further revisions subject to additional fees. Thank you for your flexibility and understanding.
